rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The statement calls 村山 "社民党初代党首で日本社会党委員長", says that among party posts he held 国会対策委員長 and 中央執行委員長, and that in 1993 he supported the 細川連立政権 "as chair of the largest governing party" ("９３年の…与党第一党の委員長として").

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The statement says that in January 1996 he changed the party's name from 日本社会党 to 社会民主党 ("９６年１月には日本社会党の党名を社会民主党に変更し").

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The statement on 村山富市元首相 says that at the first SDP convention in March of the same year (1996) he became the first 党首 ("同年３月の第１回社民党大会で初代党首に就任されました").

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The statement on 村山富市元首相 says that at the second extraordinary convention in December of the same year (1996) he passed the party leader's post to 土井たか子元委員長 ('同年１２月の第２回臨時大会では党首の座を土井たか子元委員長にバトンを渡されました').

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a schedule, a filing by several candidates, an organization event, an acting leader). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial and Speaker offices, parliamentary groups and other party offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office.
